name: Can I remove my tub if I have a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove my tub if I have a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing a tub from a small bathroom can be more challenging due to limited maneuvering space, but it is certainly possible. Our contractors are experienced in working within confined areas, using specialized tools and techniques to safely dismantle and extract the tub without damaging tight doorways or hallways. In some cases, cutting the tub into smaller pieces inside the bathroom might be necessary for easier removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, tub removal is possible in small bathrooms, though challenging. Contractors use specialized tools and techniques, sometimes cutting the tub into pieces, to manage tight spaces.
